topic: The lift of an old city building stops at a floor that does not exist in the building plan.

episode.title: Woh Manzil Jo Naqshay Mein Nahi Thi

shots.narration: عمارت میں تین منزلیں تھیں، لفٹ چوتھی پر کیسے رکی؟
shots.scene: Old Pakistani haveli courtyard at night, brass lantern between Bashir and Saad, vertical 9:16, 3D animated film look, no text or signage.
shots.action: Bashir raises four fingers toward Saad.
shots.mood: Warm lantern light beneath worried faces, cold moonlight and thin fog behind the

shots.narration: بشیر چچا بولے، اُس رات میں وہاں پہرے پر تھا۔
shots.scene: Same haveli courtyard beside a weathered wooden doorway, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no visible writing.
shots.action: Bashir lifts his old brass lantern between them.
shots.mood: Intimate storytelling, long still shadows across cracked stone.

shots.narration: [whispers] آدھی رات کو بند لفٹ خود ہی کھل گئی۔
shots.scene: Story setting: lobby of an old Pakistani city building, antique metal lift with unmarked doors, cracked plaster, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: The lift doors slide open before Bashir.
shots.mood: An unlit lift interior surrounded by pale moonlight and dusty haze.

shots.narration: دیوار کے نقشے میں صرف تین منزلیں بنی تھیں۔
shots.scene: Lobby wall beside the open lift, framed architectural cross-section showing exactly three stacked floors, diagram lines only, no letters or numbers, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bashir traces the three drawn floors with one finger.
shots.mood: Lantern glow reveals faded paper and peeling plaster.

shots.narration: میں اندر گیا، تو لفٹ اوپر چل پڑی۔
shots.scene: Inside the antique lift, plain wooden panels and a narrow glazed opening showing passing floor landings, no readable controls, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bashir steps into the lift with his lantern.
shots.mood: Cramped amber light, deep black seams between wooden panels.

shots.narration: [surprised] تین منزلیں گزریں، مگر لفٹ پھر بھی نہیں رکی۔
shots.scene: Lift interior with the final illuminated landing slipping below the narrow glazed opening, bare shaft darkness above, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: The last landing slides downward out of Bashir's view.
shots.mood: Lantern-lit profile against a window turning completely black.

shots.narration: پھر دروازہ کھلا، سامنے ایک لمبی راہداری تھی۔
shots.scene: Lift threshold opening onto an impossibly long corridor, damp plaster, identical closed unmarked doors, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation.
shots.action: The lift doors part to reveal the corridor.
shots.mood: Blue fog pools along the floor beyond a small circle of amber light.

shots.narration: میں نے لالٹین باہر رکھی، مگر خود اندر رہا۔
shots.scene: Low view across the open lift threshold into the empty corridor, vertical 9:16, no writing or signs.
shots.action: Bashir places his brass lantern on the corridor floor.
shots.mood: A sharp boundary between warm lantern light and the black lift.

shots.narration: [whispers] میرا سایہ راہداری میں تھا، مگر روشنی غلط طرف تھی۔
shots.scene: Open lift behind a floor lantern, Bashir standing inside, a long human-shaped shadow extending away into the corridor despite the lantern being in front of him, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bashir points toward the wrongly directed shadow.
shots.mood: Unnatural shadow geometry across cold tiles, empty doorways fading into mist.

shots.narration: میں پیچھے ہٹا، مگر سایہ وہیں کھڑا رہا۔
shots.scene: View from the corridor into the open lift, lantern outside the threshold, detached upright shadow on the corridor wall, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Bashir backs against the lift's rear wall.
shots.mood: His frightened face catches a thin amber glow while the shadow remains rigid.

shots.narration: پھر وہ سایہ، میرے بغیر ہی لفٹ میں آگیا۔
shots.scene: Lift interior facing the open doorway, brass lantern still outside, oversized detached shadow crossing the threshold toward Bashir, vertical 9:16, no additional figures.
shots.action: The detached shadow crawls up the wall behind Bashir.
shots.mood: Towering black silhouette surrounds his small lantern-lit face, deepest suspense

shots.narration: [whispers] اگلی رات سعد بولا، چچا، وہاں سیڑھیاں بھی جاتی ہیں۔
shots.scene: Following night in the haveli courtyard, Bashir beside his brass lantern, Saad facing an open doorway containing narrow stairs ascending into darkness, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Saad points his small torch up the staircase.
shots.mood: Quiet cliffhanger, a thin white torch beam disappearing above the lantern glow.

episode.endHook: Agli raat, usi manzil tak jaane wali seerhiyan mil gayin...
episode.description: بشیر چچا سعد کو ایک پرانی عمارت کی لفٹ کا قصہ سناتے ہیں، جو ایسی منزل پر رک گئی جس کا نقشے میں نام و نشان نہیں تھا۔ رات کی کہانیاں کی یہ قسط ایک مکمل خیالی کہانی ہے۔
